_readme: Overrides for the landing page (the guru vandana gate at the repository root, index.html).
The defaults live in the SITE_CONFIG block inside index.html. Anything you put here
wins over them, so the page can be reworded, repointed or restyled without touching
markup. Leave a key out and the default stands.
Objects merge key by key. Arrays are replaced whole — to change one contributor
section you must list all of them, which is also how you reorder or drop one.
An empty file, a missing file or a malformed one all leave the defaults in place.
The gate never fails to draw because of this file.
WHAT YOU CAN SET
enterUrl          where 'Enter the Library' goes. Default 'dge/index.html'.
requireOffering   false lets visitors straight through, vandana still shown.
minOfferings      how many offerings unlock the gate. Default 1.
passKey           sessionStorage key the dge/ guard looks for. Change it here
and in dge/js/vandana-guard.js together, or the guard will
bounce everyone back forever.
photo             src, alt, frameRatio, objectPosition, and offerX / offerY /
offerW / offerH — where the flowers come to rest on the arch.
brand             latin, tagline.
guru              nameSanskrit, nameLatin, title, moreLabel.
vandana           sanskrit (HTML allowed), transliteration.
labels            hint, offerButton, pranamButton, enterLocked, enterReady,
readMore, readLess, sectionsCue.
flowers           petal colours, sizes, maxSettled.
pranam            count — how many prostration figures the button scatters.
sections          array, in page order: the contributor bands.
panels            the 'Know More' sheets, keyed by the section's panel name.
footer.lines      array of { sa, latin }.
EXAMPLE — send visitors somewhere else and reword the entry button:
{ "enterUrl": "dge/library.html",
"labels": { "enterReady": "Enter" } }
